provider.name: Plazi TreatmentBank
provider.organization_type: taxonomic-literature extraction, treatment, nomenclatural-act, publication, material-citation, specimen, figure, linked-data, API, download, and annotation infrastructure
provider.description: Plazi and TreatmentBank transform taxonomic publications into structured, linked, machine-readable data. The infrastructure exposes taxonomic treatments, scientific names, nomenclatural acts, publications, bibliographic references, material citations, specimens, collection codes, localities, figures, tables, people, places, external identifiers, XML, RDF, JSON-LD, APIs, downloads, software, and provenance.
institutional_context: Publishers, museums, repositories, taxonomists, and biodiversity infrastructures
GoldenGATE annotation and extraction software ecosystem
External authorities including GBIF, ZooBank, Crossref, BHL, ORCID, ROR, and Catalogue of Life

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Plazi and TreatmentBank documentation, organization, governance, treatments, scientific names, nomenclatural acts, publications, material citations, specimens, figures, tables, annotation workflows, APIs, linked data, downloads, schemas, quality control, licenses, citations, software, publishers, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Plazi, TreatmentBank, official repositories and documentation, source publications, publishers, nomenclatural registries, museum collections, taxonomic authorities, and cited external databases remain authoritative for identifiers, names, acts, specimens, rights, versions, and contact information.
